labels.quick_use_body:
1. Choose folders + Scan.
2. Pick Lossless or Glitch.
3. Preview/tune one clip.
4. Apply Selected or Folder.

labels.theme_help: Choose a published or locally saved interface theme.
labels.welcome_description: Prepare camera footage for OmN-e Waves, preserve upload-safe lossless clips, and build restrained glitch-art conversion recipes.

tooltips.about_updates: Open release information, website/support links and the automatic updater. Update checks are read from omne.space.
tooltips.afterglow: Persistence of bright pixels between frames, similar to slow sensor/display decay. Useful for headlights, reflections, sunsets and luminous motion trails.
tooltips.apply_folder: Queue every scanned source using the current operation and Inspector settings. Jobs run one at a time to avoid CPU/disk contention.
tooltips.apply_selected: Queue only the clip currently selected in Preview. Use this to validate a recipe before processing the full camera folder.
tooltips.blur: Apply Gaussian softening after the temporal/colour effects. Small values blend harsh digital edges into a hazy, nostalgic image.
tooltips.browse: Open a folder picker for this path instead of typing it manually.
tooltips.browse_output: Choose a separate destination for clips and effect renders. Do not choose the raw camera folder.
tooltips.browse_source: Select the camera/source folder. Nothing is converted until you queue a job.
tooltips.camera_folder: Folder containing the original camera videos. Use Browse to select it, then Scan so the Preview and Apply Folder controls know which files to process.
tooltips.cancel_preview: Stop the active preview FFmpeg process without affecting queued/full conversions.
tooltips.cancel_running: Terminate the currently active batch FFmpeg process. Already completed jobs and source files are left intact.
tooltips.check_now: Immediately fetch the current update manifest from omne.space and compare its version with this installation.
tooltips.check_updates_startup: When enabled, perform a non-blocking update check shortly after every launch. Conversion still works when the update service is offline.
tooltips.chroma_shift: Offset colour channels horizontally/vertically while keeping luminance readable. Creates camera/circuit-bent colour bleeding without destroying scene structure.
tooltips.continue: Close the welcome/update panel and return to Footage Lab.
tooltips.copy_all: Copy the entire visible diagnostics report to the clipboard for troubleshooting. Review file paths and other details before sharing.
tooltips.copy_job_log: Copy the selected job's most recent FFmpeg log to the clipboard. If no job log is selected, the latest preview log or diagnostics are copied instead.
tooltips.crf: x264 quality target for the final stable H.264 bake. Lower numbers retain more detail and create larger files; higher numbers add compression and shrink files.
tooltips.customize_theme: Open the live Theme Studio. Every colour and sizing adjustment is applied to the running interface immediately; save the result as a local theme when you want to keep it.
tooltips.diagnostics: Open a copyable report containing versions, paths, current Inspector values, job states and recent FFmpeg/session logs for debugging.
tooltips.diagnostics_text: Read or copy the diagnostic report. Raw FFmpeg messages are kept unchanged so errors can be diagnosed accurately.
tooltips.download_install: Download the platform package from omne.space, verify its SHA-256 hash, install it, and then offer to restart the app.
tooltips.echo_decay: How quickly older echo frames fade. Low values keep only a faint immediate echo; high values make earlier frames remain prominent for longer.
tooltips.echo_frames: Number of recent frames mixed into the present frame. Higher values leave longer visual trails and repetitions behind moving subjects.
tooltips.enable_tooltips: Show concise utility help when hovering interface controls. Turn this off if you already know the workflow and prefer a quieter interface.
tooltips.format_tab: Encoding/output controls used for glitch derivatives. Lossless mode ignores these because it preserves the source streams.
tooltips.fps: Output frame cadence for glitch renders. Lower values can feel more period-correct and make echo/interpolation artifacts more visible.
tooltips.generation_passes: Re-encode through MPEG-4 multiple times before the stable final bake. Each pass builds authentic generation-loss softness, block texture and motion residue.
tooltips.glitch_derivative: Render a new video using the Format and Glitch controls. The raw camera file remains untouched.
tooltips.glitch_tab: Artistic conversion controls. Start with a named preset, then change individual values and preview before committing a folder batch.
tooltips.hue_drift: Slowly oscillate hue over time. Small values create subtle unstable camera colour; large values become intentionally psychedelic.
tooltips.inspector: Controls how the selected source or whole folder will be processed. Preview uses the same glitch recipe through a faster proxy.
tooltips.inspector_tabs: Switch between output-format controls and artistic effects. Each tab remembers its own scroll position.
tooltips.interpolation_source_fps: Cadence fed into the motion interpolator. Lower values remove more real motion information, creating stronger invented in-between motion and warping.
tooltips.length: Duration of the preview test. Short tests are faster; use a few extra seconds when judging echoes, afterglow or interpolation behavior.
tooltips.liquid_warp: Strength of smooth animated displacement maps. Higher values bend the image like moving glass rather than breaking it into random pixel blocks.
tooltips.lossless: Preserve the camera's encoded video/audio packets. Files under the size limit are copied; larger files are clipped with FFmpeg stream-copy, so there is no new codec generation.
tooltips.max_bitrate: Peak video data rate used to estimate safe clip lengths and cap encoded bandwidth. Lower values can increase compression artifacts and reduce upload size.
tooltips.max_upload: Hard maximum size for each finished upload file. Lossless mode stream-copies and splits around keyframes; glitch mode renders then splits any rare oversize result without another visual encode.
tooltips.motion_interpolation: Discard some temporal samples and ask motion compensation to reconstruct them. Its imperfect guesses create smooth liquid deformation around moving objects.
tooltips.open_logs: Open the persistent log folder. Use these files when a conversion fails before the UI can explain the FFmpeg error clearly.
tooltips.open_logs_folder: Open the persistent application log folder in the file manager.
tooltips.open_output: Open the active output folder in the system file manager so you can inspect completed derivatives.
tooltips.operation: Choose whether to preserve the original encoded streams and only clip them, or render a separate artistic glitch derivative.
tooltips.operation_summary: Summary of the current processing mode. Lossless clipping preserves encoded packets; effect rendering uses the selected recipe.
tooltips.output: Destination root for lossless clips, glitch derivatives, metadata and work files. Keep this separate from the raw camera folder.
tooltips.play_pause: Pause or resume the in-panel preview animation after a preview has successfully rendered.
tooltips.preset: Load a named glitch recipe. Built-in presets remain available; manual recipes can be saved as custom presets for reuse.
tooltips.preset_help: Your saved visual recipes stay on this computer and are preserved through application updates.
tooltips.preview: The full preview frame is centred and scaled to fit this panel, including portrait footage. Drag the visible borders to give it more space. Preview rendering uses a reduced proxy; resizing this panel does not rerender the video.
tooltips.preview_controls: The full preview frame is centred and scaled to fit this panel, including portrait footage. Drag the visible borders to give it more space. Preview rendering uses a reduced proxy; resizing this panel does not rerender the video.
tooltips.preview_heading: The full preview frame is centred and scaled to fit this panel, including portrait footage. Drag the visible borders to give it more space. Preview rendering uses a reduced proxy; resizing this panel does not rerender the video.
tooltips.preview_progress: Completion of the short preview render and display-frame preparation. This does not represent the full-folder batch.
tooltips.preview_status: Current preview stage or result. Scroll sideways to read a long message without reflowing the preview controls.
tooltips.preview_visual: The full preview frame is centred and scaled to fit this panel, including portrait footage. Drag the visible borders to give it more space. Preview rendering uses a reduced proxy; resizing this panel does not rerender the video.
tooltips.processes: Monitor batch work. Rows show queued, running, completed, failed or cancelled jobs plus the current stage and percentage.
tooltips.queue_status: Counts of running, queued, completed and failed jobs in this session and restored history.
tooltips.quick_use: Four-step reminder of the normal workflow. The owner can edit this wording in the Labels section of the Customiser.
tooltips.refresh: Rebuild the diagnostics text from the current job states and logs.
tooltips.release_notes: Changes supplied by the publisher for the available application release.
tooltips.render_preview: Render the chosen time range through the current glitch recipe and display it here. Preview is intentionally reduced for responsiveness.
tooltips.repair_retry: Delete only the selected job's recorded derivative outputs, then queue the same job again. Raw source files are never removed.
tooltips.reset_defaults: Restore application folders and Inspector values to factory defaults. Custom presets, converted media, logs and job history are kept.
tooltips.resize_inspector: Drag to rebalance Operation and Inspector tabs. Operation cannot expand past the height its contents need; Format and Glitch scroll independently.
tooltips.resize_outer: Drag a raised horizontal handle to give the workspace or process list more height. Source controls stop expanding once their content fits; shorten the section to scroll inside it.
tooltips.resize_preview: Drag to allocate height between Preview controls and the image. The image always fits inside its area without scrollbars or cropping.
tooltips.resize_workspace: Drag the vertical handle to give more width to Inspector or Preview. Minimum widths keep both sides usable.
tooltips.resolution: Output frame size for glitch renders. Smaller sizes strengthen early-digital texture and render faster; Source keeps the camera dimensions.
tooltips.retry: Queue the selected job again with the exact settings originally assigned to it. Useful for transient failures without changing the recipe.
tooltips.saturation: Colour intensity after the glitch chain. Values above 1 make colours more vivid; values below 1 produce faded or forlorn colour.
tooltips.save_preset: Save the current Format + Glitch controls as a reusable custom preset. Folder paths and upload limits are intentionally not stored in visual presets.
tooltips.scan: Read the selected camera folder and populate the source list. Scanning does not convert or modify any video.
tooltips.scan_status: Number and combined on-disk size of the videos found in the last folder scan.
tooltips.scan_strength: Darken alternating horizontal luma rows to exaggerate scan/field texture. Keep moderate if the original scene should remain easy to interpret.
tooltips.scroll_vertical: Scroll within this section to reach controls below the visible area. The other sections do not move.
tooltips.show_welcome: Show the compact website/support/update panel whenever Footage Lab starts.
tooltips.source: Select which scanned camera clip is used for Preview or Apply Selected.
tooltips.source_output: Choose where the untouched camera files live and where converted derivatives should be written. Source files are never edited in place.
tooltips.start: Seconds from the beginning of the selected source where the preview test should start. Pick a section containing the kind of motion/light you want to judge.
tooltips.support: Open the stable omne.space support page; the underlying donation provider can change without requiring a new application build.
tooltips.update_status: Fetch the release manifest over HTTPS and compare versions. SHA-256 checks download integrity; it is not a digital signature or proof against a compromised publisher.
tooltips.updates: Fetch the release manifest over HTTPS and compare versions. SHA-256 checks download integrity; it is not a digital signature or proof against a compromised publisher.
tooltips.visit_site: Open omne.space in your default browser.
tooltips.welcome_description: Overview of the local footage workflow. The application does not upload your camera files automatically.
tooltips.welcome_heading: Application name set by the publisher. Use the links below for the project website and support page.
tooltips.welcome_version: Version of the application code currently running, not a queued or merely downloaded update.
tooltips.x264: Encoder speed/efficiency tradeoff. Faster settings preview and batch faster; slower settings usually compress the same quality into less data.
